run.command: yardr group add runners --runner exec --set cmd=make --set dir=/synthetic/yard/work --set worktrees=/synthetic/yard/work
run.description: Add a new group without replacing one
does: adds the group runners on the exec runner, with limit 1, the runner's default.
Each session runs sh -c with "make", as its program stands when the session starts.
Its bead worktrees are made under /synthetic/yard/work.
It sets no env_file: the operator gives one in a terminal, with yardr group set runners env_file=<file>.

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: a new group runners on the exec runner, whose sessions the yard will start as the card shows
